name: Albert Einstein Institution

observed_activities.text: Publishes monographs and primers on nonviolent struggle, including the catalogue of 198 methods compiled by Gene Sharp.
Distributes translations of Sharp's writings on strategic nonviolent action to researchers, educators, and activists internationally.

public_positions.text: States its mission as advancing the worldwide study and strategic use of nonviolent action.
